category_edits.rationale: Reduce maximum causal context to max(1, floor(0.75 * L)) for all four datasets to reduce stale-history interference and recurrent computation. Existing sampling preserves the most recent interactions in chronological order; saved maxlen metadata applies the identical truncation in the generated predictor. Preserve the GRU architecture, readout, loss, optimizer, splits and epoch settings.

change_summary: Reduce causal context from 128 to 96 by default, consistently across training, validation and metadata-driven prediction for all four categories.
